Traffic movement from Cele towards Pako is smooth, with the return journey also flowing well. The Cele Link Bridge heading towards Ijesha is clear in both directions. The inner section of Nwachukwu Drive, connecting to Cele, is also experiencing free movement for both inbound and outbound traffic.

Five Star Bus has temporarily suspended all trips from Metro Manila terminals as vehicles are still unable to pass through key sections of the North Luzon Expressway (NLEX) due to flooding as of 9:30 PM, 21 July 2025.

According to NLEX Corporation, Valenzuela Interchange (NB/SB under the bridge) and Paso de Blas Southbound Entry/Exit remain impassable. Several toll plazas are also temporarily closed, including those in Paso de Blas, Meycauayan, Marilao, and Ciudad de Victoria.

Balintawak Cloverleaf is now open to all vehicles, and other areas of NLEX, SCTEX, and NLEX Connector remain passable. Continuous flood pumping operations are ongoing.
